operational_insight_and_mathematical_sol: High-volume connecting gateways characterized by multi-bank flight waves.
Large metropolitan hubs with elevated originating demand.
Carrier fortress hubs with low convective delay sensitivity.

At fortress hubs (e.g., Charlotte CLT or Dallas DFW), departing scheduled flight seats exceed checkpoint throughput by over 200%. BTS DB1B ticket coupon analysis revealed connecting fractions between 50% and 76%. Connecting passengers transfer between gates airside and NEVER pass through TSA security checkpoints. Mathematical Solution: Multiplying scheduled seats by (1 - ConnectingRatio) deflates airside seat capacity to landside originating demand.
